$comment: biopathway edge-type semantics library. Machine-readable contract shared by validate_model.py, render_svg.py, apply_edit.py and verify_outputs.py. Arrow/head semantics are ORTHOGONAL encodings: head style = regulation sign/direction; line dash = evidence directness; badges = modification type. Never overload one visual channel with two meanings.

activation.label: activation
activation.head: arrow
activation.description: A increases the activity/level of B. Filled arrowhead.

inhibition.label: inhibition
inhibition.head: tbar
inhibition.description: A decreases the activity/level/stability of B. Blunt T-bar end (no pointed arrow).

binding.label: binding / association
binding.head: none
binding.description: Physical association, docking or recruitment. Plain line, no arrowhead (direction not implied by binding itself).

phosphorylation.label: phosphorylation
phosphorylation.head: arrow
phosphorylation.description: A phosphorylates B. Filled arrowhead ending at a P badge on the target node.

dephosphorylation.label: dephosphorylation
dephosphorylation.head: tbar
dephosphorylation.description: A removes phosphate from B. T-bar end plus crossed P badge.

ubiquitination.label: ubiquitination
ubiquitination.head: arrow
ubiquitination.description: A ubiquitinates B (usually targeting it for degradation). Arrowhead plus Ub badge.

methylation.label: methylation
methylation.head: arrow
methylation.description: A methylates B. Sign depends on context; state sign explicitly in the model.

acetylation.label: acetylation
acetylation.head: arrow
acetylation.description: A acetylates B. Sign depends on context; state sign explicitly in the model.

transcriptional_regulation.label: transcriptional regulation
transcriptional_regulation.head: by-sign
transcriptional_regulation.description: A (TF or co-factor) regulates transcription of gene B. Head is arrow for activation, T-bar for repression; sign must be set.

translocation.label: translocation / transport
translocation.head: open-arrow
translocation.description: A moves to a compartment. Hollow (open) arrowhead ending at the destination compartment boundary. Target may be a compartment.

complex_formation.label: complex formation
complex_formation.head: none
complex_formation.description: Members assemble into a complex node. Plain lines joining members to the complex node.

conversion.label: biochemical conversion
conversion.head: arrow
conversion.description: A is converted into B (e.g. GDP/GTP exchange states, cleavage products).

unspecified_interaction.label: interaction (type not stated)
unspecified_interaction.head: none
unspecified_interaction.description: Source says the entities interact but does not state the mechanism. Plain line plus '?' annotation. Prefer this over guessing a typed arrow.

direct.legend: solid line = direct statement in source

indirect.legend: dashed line = inferred/indirect evidence (stated via intermediate or in a different context)

direction_encoding.directed: head style per edge type / sign
direction_encoding.undirected: no arrowhead; legend notes 'direction not stated in source'

gene.legend: italic label, rectangular node = gene (DNA locus / transcript target)

family.legend: dashed grey outline = family/class (not a single gene product) — attach edges to members where possible

compartment.legend: background region (membrane drawn as double line, nucleus as double-bordered rounded region)
